description: Finds a site's XML sitemap (robots.txt Sitemap lines, /sitemap.xml, /sitemap_index.xml, /wp-sitemap.xml, or the sitemap address given), checks it against the sitemaps.org protocol (valid XML, root and namespace, at most 50,000 addresses and 50 MB, full addresses on the same host, lastmod dates), follows a sitemap index to at most 5 sitemaps, and opens up to 20 listed addresses to find errors, redirects, noindex and canonical tags pointing elsewhere. Returns findings with plain-word fixes. Limited to 30 checks an hour per caller (shared with the other checks); results are cached for 10 minutes.

url.description: the website or page, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/page

name: check_sitemap
title: Is this site's XML sitemap working?
